        - heading "Understand Solve Systems" [level=2]
        - paragraph: Solve systems finds values satisfying several equations at once. In Solve Systems, that statement is the exact rule used on the labelled chart and in the three numerical examples. You can learn Solve Systems by trying one small example instead of long theory.
        - paragraph: Use substitution, elimination, or matrices, then check every equation. Try the example below. Write your steps and choose an answer before opening the comparison.
        - paragraph: "In real life, two lines: Their intersection solves both equations. Watch out: Checking the answer in only one equation. Test the solution in every equation."
